scripts.dev: npm run dev -w apps/api & npm run dev -w apps/web & npm run dev -w apps/crm
scripts.prepare: bash -c 'for s in ops/tooling/install-graphify-hooks.sh ops/tooling/install-watchdog-skill.sh; do if [ -f "$s" ]; then bash "$s" --quiet || exit $?; fi; done'
scripts.build: npm run prepare:api-types && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/crm
scripts.lint: npm run prefs-lint && npm run lint:eslint-prefs && npm run prepare:api-types && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web && npm run lint -w apps/crm
scripts.test: npm run prepare:api-types && npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
